name: Skip Prologue (to World Map)
description: On a brand-new save, skips the "Once upon a time..." stork prologue (game modes $37/$38/$39) and goes to the world map instead of straight into a level. Mutually exclusive with "Skip Prologue" - enable only one.
attribution: Variant of the Flutter hack's prologue skip (https://www.romhacking.net/hacks/8972/)
details: The new-game branch (CODE_179932, Bank17) defaults to gm$1F (-> overworld) then overrides to gm$37 (prologue) at $17:9953 when the per-save prologue-seen flag $1123,x is 0. This patch NOPs the 5-byte override 'LDA #$37 : STA $0118', so a fresh save stays in gm$1F and proceeds to the world map exactly like a returning save - skipping the prologue without entering a level. The following 'STZ CurrentYoshiColor ($0383)' and RTS still run. Unlike "Skip Prologue", this needs no level slot. NEEDS in-game verification.
asm: ; --- Flutter prologue-skip variant: go to the world map instead of a level ---
; NOP the gm$37 override at $17:9953 so a new game stays in gm$1F -> overworld.
